---
name: portfolio-health-check
description: Run a complete health check across code, UX, performance, security, content, and Git.
---

Run a Portfolio Health Check across:
- Code
- UX
- Performance
- Security
- Content
- Git

Report findings using Critical, Needs Attention, Improvement, and Good / No Issue. Do not invent a numerical score. Do not make major changes during the audit. Include the current branch and any production-risk findings.
